name: Darkness
overview: Scripture reveals darkness as both a literal and symbolic reality, beginning with the creation account where darkness covered the deep before God brought forth light and called the darkness Night (Genesis 1:2, 5). It is shown as a powerful, tangible force in the miraculous plague of thick darkness over Egypt, a darkness so intense it could be felt (Exodus 10:21-22). At Mount Sinai, darkness accompanied God's presence, emphasizing His holiness and the awe-inspiring nature of divine revelation (Exodus 19:16; 20:21). These passages collectively demonstrate that darkness in the Bible is not merely absence of light but often signifies God's sovereign control over creation and judgment.
